items.title: CVE-2026-132165: Drupal Fail2Install RCE Exploited in the Wild
items.summary: Drupal administrators are facing an actively exploited vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-132165, also known as Fail2Install, that can allow an unauthenticated attacker to force a live Drupal website back into its installation workflow. Under specific conditions, this can lead to complete site takeover or pre-authentication remote code execution. Drupal originally disclosed the vulnerability on November 18, […] The post CVE-2026-132165: Drupal Fail2Install RCE Exploited in the Wild appeared first on SOC Prime .

items.title: CVE-2026-132165: Drupal core remote code execution via missing authentication (Update: CVSS score changed from 9.8 to 8.1)
items.summary: Update: CVSS score changed from 9.8 to 8.1. Drupal core has a missing authentication flaw that lets an attacker use the reachable install.php installer to try to reinstall the site, which can lead to site takeover or remote code execution. This vulnerability is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, meaning attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2026-112235
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly check authorization before allowing a user to store popup preview data against arbitrary posts, nor restrict who can read that content back on public requests, allowing users granted access to the Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 to disclose the private and draft content of posts they do not own to unauthenticated visitors.

items.title: CVE-2026-112233
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not check the publish status or the visitor's capabilities before rendering a popup requested by its ID in the URL, allowing unauthenticated users to read the content and configuration of popups that are still drafts or are marked private.

items.title: CVE-2026-138120
items.summary: Kestra 1.3.24 before 2.0.0 contains a timing side-channel vulnerability in BasicAuthService.isAuthenticated() that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate the administrator username. Attackers can send Basic-auth requests with candidate usernames to protected API endpoints and detect slower bcrypt checks to identify the valid account for password guessing.

items.title: CVE-2026-138119
items.summary: Kestra before 1.3.36 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute JavaScript by injecting HTML into the executions page sort parameter. Attackers can lure logged-in users to a crafted link whose invalid sort value is rendered unsanitized in an error toast, stealing the non-HttpOnly BASIC_AUTH credential cookie to take over the instance.

items.title: CVE-2026-137974
items.summary: A flaw was found in tuned. This vulnerability allows local privilege escalation because the spindown-disk profile script does not properly validate filesystem mount sources before executing remount operations with root privileges. A local user capable of creating user-space filesystems can craft a malicious mount entry to execute arbitrary commands as root.

items.title: CVE-2026-138034
items.summary: bigcommerce-api-mcp before 1.0.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to invoke MCP tools because the /sse and /messages routes skip the authenticateRequest middleware. Attackers can open /sse to obtain a session id and POST JSON-RPC tool calls to /messages to retrieve store product, order and customer records using the operator's BigCommerce API key.

items.title: CVE-2026-136115
items.summary: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in expresstechsoftware MemberPress Discord Addon expresstechsoftwares-memberpress-discord-add-on allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects MemberPress Discord Addon: from n/a through 1.1.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-137898
items.summary: A flaw was found in pam. When built with libeconf and an unconfigured vendor directory, the pam_econf configuration handler misinterprets the search path, causing it to look for configuration files in a relative directory within the current working directory. A local attacker can exploit this by placing crafted environment configuration files in a world-writable location. If an administrator executes a privileged command from that directory, the malicious variables are loaded into the privileged process, resulting in local privilege escalation.

items.title: CVE-2026-138026
items.summary: Crypto APIs MCP server packages (@cryptoapis-io/mcp-*) before 0.4.0, mcp-blockchain-events, mcp-blockchain-fees, mcp-broadcast and mcp-prepare-transactions before 0.5.0, and mcp-aml before 0.2.0 contain a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated network attackers to invoke tools using the operator's API key. When started with Streamable HTTP transport and --api-key, the server binds 0.0.0.0 and exposes /mcp, letting attackers consume paid credits, read account data, redirect event subscriptions, and delete HD wallet xPubs.

Authenticated builders, or unauthenticated visitors of public apps with templated URLs, can supply internal URLs or hosts to read cloud metadata credentials and internal service responses.

items.summary: Sparkle 2.2.0 before 2.9.6 contains a link following vulnerability in -submitInstallerAtPath: in SUInstallerLauncher.m that builds a root updater's launcher cache path inside the console user's home directory and then deletes and creates items there without rejecting symbolic links. items.title: CVE-2026-137938
items.summary: Sparkle before 2.9.6 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in the installer's SPUInstallationData handling in AppInstaller.m, which validates the symlink-resolved download URL but performs the privileged move on the unresolved URL and checks the file type only afterwards. items.title: CVE-2026-137970
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in ssrf-protection.ts that fails to classify NAT64 (64:ff9b::/96, 64:ff9b:1::/48) and 6to4 (2002::/16) IPv6 addresses embedding internal IPv4. Authenticated users can set REST API, GraphQL, OpenAPI, or OAuth data-source URLs to attacker hostnames whose AAAA records resolve to these forms, bypassing pre-request and dial-time guards to reach cloud metadata and internal hosts.

Attackers can overwrite adjacent phonebook and calendar entry pointers via strcpy() into MD5Original when files are loaded with convertbackup or restore, causing crashes or potential code execution.

items.summary: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in ReadBackupTextLen() that allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via crafted backup files. Attackers can supply overlong quoted text values decoded into a 10,000-byte stack array during convertbackup, restore, or GSM_ReadBackupFile calls, causing crashes or potential code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-138148
items.summary: picomatch through 4.0.7 contains a glob filter bypass vulnerability because globstar (**) patterns are compiled without the dotAll flag and fail to match line terminators. Attackers who control file, object key or archive entry names containing newline characters can evade ** deny patterns, causing excluded resources to be included and exposed.

items.title: CVE-2026-138163
items.summary: Gammu before 1.45.2 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in ReadWAPSettingsEntry() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via crafted backup files with excess WAP or MMS settings entries. Attackers can supply a backup with more than four TitleNN keys in a [WAPSettings] or [MMSSettings] section, loaded via convertbackup, restore, or GSM_ReadBackupFile, causing crashes or potential code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-138158
items.summary: libgphoto2 through 2.5.34 contains a stack buffer overflow in sierra_get_string_register() that lets a malicious sierra-protocol camera or USB device overwrite stack memory. When files are listed, the device can answer the file-name register with an oversized packet, writing up to 32 KB past small stack buffers to cause crashes or possible code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-138154
items.summary: POSTAL 2 before build 26810491 contains a sandbox escape vulnerability that allows malicious Steam Workshop mods to execute code by calling ConsoleCommand with a start file URI. Attackers can ship a batch file in a mod at the predictable workshop install path and launch it via ShellExecuteW, executing commands as the player on Windows.

items.title: CVE-2026-123654
items.summary: Themify Base WordPress theme through 1.2.4 does not perform capability checks on its option save and read AJAX actions, which are protected only by a generic nonce that other commonly expose on the front end, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to update arbitrary blog options such as the default role and open registration, and gain administrator access when such a is active.

items.title: CVE-2026-112234
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not validate a user-supplied URL before requesting it server-side and storing the fetched response so that it can be read back, allowing users with Administrator privileges to perform Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attacks and read the responses of internal services.

items.title: CVE-2026-112232
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not properly sanitize and escape a popup shortcode attribute before it is reflected into a page and evaluated client-side, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to inject arbitrary JavaScript that executes in the session of any higher-privileged user, such as an administrator, who views the affected content.

items.title: CVE-2026-112231
items.summary: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not sanitise or escape a custom styling value before storing it and printing it back into the pages a popup loads on, allowing users who are allowed to manage popups (an ability that can be delegated to lower-privileged roles) to inject JavaScript that executes in the browser of every visitor, including logged-in administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-138153
items.summary: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the Posts Grid block and Atomic Wind query loop that allows Contributor-level attackers to read non-public post type entries. Attackers can set the postTypes or queryPostType block attributes to types like flamingo_inbound or shop_coupon to expose titles and text, while the Atomic Wind custom_field path also leaks protected post meta.

items.title: CVE-2026-138152
items.summary: Otter – Page Builder Blocks & Extensions for Gutenberg before 3.2.12 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Contributor-level attackers to make the server contact arbitrary hosts via crafted Mailchimp API keys. Attackers can POST to the otter/v1/form/editor REST route with an apiKey whose data-center segment embeds a host, following redirects to internal services and reading partial responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-138151
items.summary: bgpq4 before 1.17 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in expander.c that allows malicious IRR servers to corrupt heap memory by sending crafted A replies. Attackers controlling the IRR server or tampering with the plaintext TCP connection can announce a ULONG_MAX or -1 length, wrapping the allocation to one byte and crashing bgpq4.

items.title: CVE-2026-138150
items.summary: SimGear through 2024.1.7 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in sgSimpleBuffer::resize() where an unsigned 32-bit wraparound in the size-doubling loop leaves the size at zero. Attackers can supply a crafted .btg scenery file with an oversized byte count exceeding 2^31 to hang the loading process in FlightGear.

items.title: CVE-2026-138149
items.summary: FeatBit before 6.1.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated members of one organization to read other organizations' segments by supplying foreign segment identifiers. Attackers can query the SegmentController segment, by-ids, and flag-references endpoints with their own envId to retrieve end-user keys, targeting rules, and referencing feature flag keys.

items.title: CVE-2026-138122
items.summary: ClassroomIO through 1.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated course members to access other tenants' newsfeed posts by supplying a foreign feedId under their own courseId. Attackers can read, react to, and comment on cross-organization posts, while team members or org admins can also overwrite content, pin flags, and delete them.

items.title: CVE-2026-138121
items.summary: Kestra 1.3.24 before 1.3.41 contains an insufficient credential expiration vulnerability that allows holders of a revoked administrator password to keep authenticating on peer webserver nodes through BasicAuthService's process-local verified-token cache. Attackers whose token remains cached on a peer node can call POST /api/v1/{tenant}/basicAuth to overwrite the shared administrator credentials and lock out the legitimate administrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-138118
items.summary: HyperSpy from 1.4.0 before 2.6.0 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute arbitrary Python code by supplying crafted stored-model data in .hspy or .zspy files. Attackers can embed a malicious pickle payload in a component's _class_dump or a 'fn'-flagged _whitelist entry, which cloudpickle.loads() (dill in 1.x) runs when the victim restores the model.

items.title: CVE-2026-138117
items.summary: HyperSpy from 1.2.0 before 2.6.0 contains a code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run Python code by embedding malicious expression strings evaluated with sympy.sympify(). Attackers can craft .hspy or .zspy files with malicious axis, Expression component, or twin function expressions that execute when victims call hs.load() or restore models.

items.title: CVE-2026-107951
items.summary: Improper Content Security Policy (CSP) configuration in the BigFix MCM WebUI allowed the data: URI scheme as a source in the img-src directive of the CSP header. This potentially weakens the application's defense-in-depth security mechanism.

items.title: CVE-2026-138004
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in TRENDnet TEW-751DR and TEW-733GR 1.03B01. Affected is the function soapcgi_main of the file /soap.cgi of the component UPnP Igd Control Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument service leads to os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-138159
items.summary: edbrowse through 3.8.19 contains an integer overflow in stringAndBytes() that allows malicious servers to write past a heap buffer by sending response bodies larger than 2 GB. When a user browses to an attacker-controlled HTTP, FTP, or gopher server, the oversized body skips reallocation and corrupts the heap, causing crashes or potentially code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-138003
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in TRENDnet TEW-751DR 1.03B01. This impacts the function FUN_0040ed90 of the file wfadev.cgi of the component UPnP/WFA. This manipulation of the argument SOAPAction causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. A high degree of complexity is needed for the attack. The exploitability is said to be difficult. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-136113
items.summary: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Hello Clever Pty Hello Clever Gateway for WooCommerce cleverpay-gateway allows SQL Injection.This issue affects Hello Clever Gateway for WooCommerce: from n/a through 1.8.4.

items.title: CVE-2026-134129
items.summary: smalot/pdfparser before 2.14.0 contains an inefficient algorithmic complexity vulnerability that allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service by submitting a crafted PDF with deeply nested unbalanced parentheses in a content-stream string. Attackers can exploit the regex-based string isolation loop in PDFObject::formatContent(), which rescans growing content on each pass to produce O(n^2) processing time, causing a small PDF to stall or exhaust PHP worker resources for seconds to minutes.

items.title: CVE-2026-138048
items.summary: ntfy before v2.38.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to bypass the web push endpoint allow-list by crafting a URL containing '#' or '?' characters that satisfy the [^/]+ regex pattern used to validate mozaws.net and notify.windows.com hosts. Attackers can submit an endpoint .example#.mozaws.net/push, which passes validation while Go parses the actual host as attacker.example, causing the server to send subsequent web push POST requests to an attacker-controlled or internal host.

items.title: CVE-2026-138033
items.summary: mcp-video-analyzer 0.2.0 before 0.10.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to reach internal addresses by supplying any http(s) URL ending in a video extension. Attackers can use prompt injection to make tools like get_frames fetch loopback, private, or cloud metadata addresses directly or via redirects, writing responses to disk or returning rendered screenshots.

items.title: CVE-2026-138029
items.summary: Wazuh-MCP-Server before commit 2bbfe12 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the blueteam_check_webshell tool because WebshellCheckInput.validate_url accepts DNS hostnames without resolving them. Attackers can supply URLs whose hostnames resolve or redirect to loopback, private, or link-local addresses, making curl reach internal services and cloud metadata endpoints and leak response details.

items.title: CVE-2026-138028
items.summary: Bagel (bagel-mcp) before 2.5.5 contains an argument injection vulnerability in RsyncFilesToLocalDirectory that allows attackers to inject rsync options because only --quiet and --log-format values are rejected. Attackers who influence the LLM through prompt-injected content can trigger run_pipeline with -e/--rsh or --rsync-path options to execute commands as the Bagel server process.

items.title: CVE-2026-107967
items.summary: HCL Verse for Android included a decryption code for compatibility with locally stored values and attachment files created by older application versions (no longer used for data stored by newer versions). HCL Verse for Android version 14.5.16 (November 2026) removed the legacy decryption code.

items.title: CVE-2026-81053
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition') vulnerability. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-132876
items.summary: Dreamweaver Desktop is affected by a Dependency on Vulnerable Third-Party Component vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation depends on conditions beyond the attacker's control and requires user interaction in that a victim must open a malicious file. Scope is changed.

items.title: CVE-2026-137979
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the Nmap Scripting Engine because nse_main.lua does not explicitly seed Lua's math.random generator. Malicious scanned hosts can observe math.random-derived values in NSE script traffic during -sC scans, brute-force the seed, and recover a heap address that weakens ASLR.

items.title: CVE-2026-137978
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in DNS::ResolverImpl::process_request in libnetutil/massdns.cc that frees still-referenced requests when rescheduling after DNS server disconnects. Attackers answering for at least two configured DNS servers can force a disconnect and send a precisely timed response to crash the scan, possibly enabling code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-137965
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users with the TEST_CONNECTION ability to reach arbitrary hosts by supplying body-controlled datasource options. Attackers can set kind, plugin_id, and host options for plugins like influxdb or elasticsearch to reach loopback, internal services, or cloud metadata endpoints exposing IAM credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-137960
items.summary: Budibase backend-core before 3.49.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated Builder/Creator users to bypass the outbound-fetch deny list by targeting the IPv6 unspecified address. Attackers can supply URLs with host [::] to features like Outgoing Webhook or REST datasources to reach IPv6 loopback services and read reflected internal responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-137957
items.summary: n8n before 1.123.96, 2.47.6, 2.48.3, and 3.2.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in integration nodes that build API request paths from unencoded record, table, or resource ID parameters. Attackers can supply relative path segments through untrusted input such as webhook bodies to read, modify, or delete unintended resources using the node's stored credential.

items.title: CVE-2026-137952
items.summary: svglib before 2.5.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in SvgRenderer.renderNode() that recursively renders internal href fragment references without expansion limits or cycle detection. Attackers can supply crafted SVGs to svg2rlg() with nested groups referencing each other twice or self-referencing images to cause exponential resource consumption or RecursionError crashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-81055
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Observable Timing Discrepancy vulnerability. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Session theft.

items.title: CVE-2026-81054
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information exposure.

items.title: CVE-2026-137941
items.summary: A flaw was found in GIMP. The Levels configuration setter does not validate the channel enum before using it to index fixed-size per-channel arrays. A crafted XCF file with a non-destructive Levels filter can set an out-of-range channel (LUMINANCE or RGB), causing a heap out-of-bounds read and write when the file is opened. This may lead to a crash or arbitrary code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-81044
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Script injection.

items.title: CVE-2026-81042
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information exposure.

items.title: CVE-2026-81041
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Denial of service and Information exposure.

items.title: CVE-2026-137999
items.summary: JSONSchema2PoPo2 through 3.0.3 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject Python code by supplying JSON Schema default or format values that are written unescaped. Attackers can place a single quote in a string property default to break out of the literal in the generated __init__ signature, executing injected code when the generated module is imported.

items.title: CVE-2026-137998
items.summary: Detoxify 0.5.3 through 0.5.4 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability in load_checkpoint that allows attackers to execute code by supplying a crafted checkpoint file. Attackers can embed a pickle __reduce__ gadget in a .ckpt file loaded via torch.load with weights_only=False to run code with the user's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137997
items.summary: HCIPy through 0.7.1 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted .pkl files to read_field, read_grid or read_mode_basis. Because hcipy/util/io.py selects pickle by file extension and calls pickle.load, a __reduce__ gadget in a pupil, apodizer, PSF or mode-basis file runs code with the user's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137994
items.summary: Leo through 6.8.10 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by embedding pickled data in unknown XML attributes of .leo outlines. Attackers can place a pickle __reduce__ gadget in a or element attribute that resolveUa passes to pickle.loads, executing code with user privileges when the outline is opened.

items.title: CVE-2026-137992
items.summary: libexpat through 2.11.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in defineAttribute() of lib/xmlparse.c that fails to detect duplicate non-ID #IMPLIED or #REQUIRED attribute declarations. Attackers can supply a crafted XML document with repeated ATTLIST declarations in an internal DTD subset to cause quadratic CPU consumption in storeAtts() during parsing.

items.title: CVE-2026-81040
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Filesystem access for attacker.

items.title: CVE-2026-80512
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information exposure.

items.summary: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type vulnerability in theMarketer theMarketer themarketer allows Using Malicious Files.This issue affects theMarketer: from n/a through 1.5.9.

items.title: CVE-2026-135024
items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Ahmad WP Job Portal wp-job-portal allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP Job Portal: from n/a through 2.9.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-135019
items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Ahmad WP Job Portal wp-job-portal allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP Job Portal: from n/a through 2.9.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-137977
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in DNS::ResolverImpl::handle_write in libnetutil/massdns.cc that dereferences freed request objects after writes complete. Attackers controlling or on-path to a DNS server can send timed DNS responses with forged ICMP port-unreachable messages to crash scans, disclose memory, or hijack execution.

items.summary: The MCUmgr SMP client matched an incoming response to a pending command in smp_client_response_discover() (subsys/mgmt/mcumgr/smp_client/src/client.c) using only the 8-bit sequence number and the operation. It did not check the transport the response arrived on, or the group and command ID. smp_process_request_packet() hands every MGMT_OP_READ_RSP/MGMT_OP_WRITE_RSP packet received on any SMP transport to smp_client_single_response(), so a response from any SMP peer could complete any pending client command. On a device that is both an SMP server (for example over Bluetooth LE or UDP) and an SM…

items.title: CVE-2026-80509
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Script injection.

items.title: CVE-2026-80501
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-80504
items.summary: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization ('Race Condition') vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137973
items.summary: Heym from 0.0.95 before 0.0.154 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to run script on the application origin by publishing HTML output mapper workflows. Attackers can set a workflow to anonymous GET and share the /api/workflows/{id}/execute link, causing visitors' browsers to send authenticated API requests to read or modify their workflows, credentials, and settings.

items.title: CVE-2026-137972
items.summary: Heym before 0.0.154 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the workflow execute endpoint: anonymous workflows run as any signed-in caller, without an access check, using that caller's credentials and global variables. Authenticated attackers can lure signed-in users to a GET execute link for an attacker-owned anonymous workflow, which the SameSite=Lax session cookie authenticates. The attacker then reads the victim's decrypted credentials from the workflow's run history.

items.title: CVE-2026-137967
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to make the server fetch internal URLs via the gRPC v2 proto_file_url option. Attackers can target loopback, private, cloud metadata, or redirect-controlled addresses, or serve oversized responses that are buffered and parsed synchronously, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137966
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an arbitrary file read and SSRF vulnerability in the SMTP plugin that allows authenticated app builders to pass object values to Nodemailer. Attackers can set textContent or htmlContent to path or href content objects to email server files or internal cloud metadata responses to themselves.

items.title: CVE-2026-137964
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a command injection vulnerability in its GitHub Actions release workflow, which interpolates the pull request title directly into a shell run block. Attackers can submit a pull request against a release branch with shell metacharacters in its title that, once merged, executes commands with a cross-repository GITHUB_TOKEN, enabling unauthorized merges into enterprise repositories.

items.title: CVE-2026-137962
items.summary: Budibase server before 3.48.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the public API view row search endpoint that skips per-view permission checks due to a tableId/viewId parameter mismatch. Authenticated users with READ_ONLY role and an API key can query restricted views to read data limited to higher-privileged roles.

items.title: CVE-2026-137961
items.summary: Budibase before 3.51.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the workspace create handler that allows authenticated CREATOR users to probe server paths by supplying an unvalidated body.file.path value. Attackers can enumerate filesystem existence and type, and for directories containing db.txt, copy contents into their object store namespace before the directory is recursively deleted.

items.title: CVE-2026-137959
items.summary: n8n before 1.123.96, 2.x before 2.47.6, 2.48.x before 2.48.3, and 3.x before 3.2.2 does not verify that the user activating a workflow can access the credentials set on its trigger nodes. An authenticated member who knows another user's credential ID can activate a workflow whose trigger uses it, causing n8n to create or delete webhooks on the connected service with that credential's privileges and deliver events from attacker-chosen resources to the member's workflow.

items.title: CVE-2026-137958
items.summary: n8n before 2.47.6, 2.48.x before 2.48.3, and 3.x before 3.2.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the AWS Bedrock Chat Model and Embeddings AWS Bedrock nodes, where requests to a custom Bedrock runtime endpoint set in an AWS credential bypass n8n's SSRF protection. An authenticated user who can create AWS credentials can point the endpoint at internal or blocked addresses, causing n8n to send requests there and exposing the start of responses in node errors.

items.title: CVE-2026-137956
items.summary: AVideo from 29.1.0 before 29.8.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in plugin/YPTWallet/view/saveConfiguration.php that lets attackers modify a logged-in user's wallet configuration. Attackers can lure victims to a page auto-submitting a cross-origin POST with CryptoWallet and donation_notification_url to redirect payouts and capture donation notifications.

items.title: CVE-2026-137953
items.summary: Pydantic Deep 0.2.18 before 0.4.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the bundled DeepResearch FastAPI app that exposes HTTP routes and the /ws/chat WebSocket. Remote attackers reaching the server bound to all interfaces can enumerate sessions, read event logs and workspace files, drive the research agent, and delete sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-138032
items.summary: WhoDB from 0.88.0 before 0.132.0 contains an access control bypass in the MCP whodb_query tool, letting callers run file-writing statements without approval because the sqlguard keyword classifier omits INTO, OUTFILE and DUMPFILE. MCP clients or prompt-injected models can execute PostgreSQL lo_export or MySQL SELECT INTO OUTFILE to create files on the database host and create tables, bypassing confirmation and read-only modes.

items.title: CVE-2026-138031
items.summary: Typebot from 2.14.0 before 3.19.0 contains an authorization flaw that allows authenticated bot authors to reference another workspace's legacy webhook by saving a foreign webhookId in an HTTP request block. Attackers can have executeHttpRequestBlock return the victim's URL, headers and body client-side, or use handleSubscribeHttpRequest to overwrite the victim's webhook URL and redirect its data.

items.title: CVE-2026-138027
items.summary: Bagel (bagel-mcp) before 2.5.5 exposes unsandboxed DuckDB SQL execution through the read-only annotated query_messages MCP tool, allowing file access and network requests. Attackers who prompt-inject the driving LLM via recorded logs or topics can invoke read_csv_auto, COPY TO, or httpfs to read and write files and perform server-side request forgery.

items.title: CVE-2026-110739
items.summary: An Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs in the namespace onboarding API in Google Cloud GKE Fleet versions prior to 2026-09-25 on Google Cloud Platform allows an authenticated attacker to escalate privileges to project owner using a privileged system namespace onboarding request. This vulnerability was patched on 25 September 2026, and no customer action is needed.

items.title: CVE-2026-129817
items.summary: ** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Improper Authentication vulnerability in Apache Submarine. This issue affects Apache Submarine: all versions. Authorization rules on the API can be bypassed. As this project is retired, we do not plan to release a version that fixes this issue. Users are recommended to find an alternative or restrict access to the instance to trusted users. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

items.title: CVE-2026-137746
items.summary: A flaw has been found in Free5GC 4.3.0. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the component SMF. This manipulation causes resource consumption. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

items.title: CVE-2026-85252
items.summary: A SQL Injection vulnerability in the Revenue Reports API in Google Cloud Apigee Edge Monetization versions prior to 2026-07-16 (Public Cloud) and OPDK 4.54.00 (Private Cloud) on Apigee Edge Public Cloud and Apigee Edge for Private Cloud (OPDK) allows an authenticated attacker to gain unauthorized read access to the underlying database using crafted report filtering criteria. items.title: CVE-2026-137907
items.summary: FFmpeg 3.0 before 8.1.3 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_boxblur.c because query_formats() accepts pixel formats deeper than 16 bits while the blur temporary buffers hold only 2 bytes per pixel. Attackers can supply crafted 32-bit float media, such as PFM or OpenEXR images, that when processed by the boxblur filter overflow the temporary buffers, crashing applications or possibly executing code.

Attackers can supply a crafted IMF Composition Playlist whose virtual track lists no resources, causing set_context_streams_from_tracks() to dereference a NULL resource array and crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-137888
items.summary: Flowintel contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in its HedgeDoc case-notes integration. When a user with editor or administrator privileges associates a HedgeDoc URL with a case, the application later issues a server-side HTTP GET request to that URL to retrieve note content. Before the fix, the stored URL was used directly without validation of its scheme, host, port, path, or userinfo, and the HTTP client followed redirects by default with no connect or read timeouts. An authenticated attacker could therefore cause the Flowintel server to issue requests to arbitrary int…

items.title: CVE-2026-137911
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in xwd_encode_frame() in libavcodec/xwdenc.c that copies each RGB24 or BGR24 row using the padded XWD scanline size instead of the pixel row size. Attackers who control the width of video encoded to XWD by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents into the output image.

items.title: CVE-2026-137910
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in pcx_encode_frame() in libavcodec/pcxenc.c that rounds each row up to an even number of bytes and run-length encodes that many bytes from the input frame. Attackers who control the width of images encoded to PCX by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the end of the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents into the output image.

items.title: CVE-2026-137909
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xsub_encode() in libavcodec/xsubenc.c that only warns when a subtitle has no rectangles and then dereferences rects[0]. Attackers can supply crafted PGS or DVB subtitles that decode to empty subtitle events, crashing applications that pass decoded subtitles directly to the XSUB encoder.

items.title: CVE-2026-137908
items.summary: FFmpeg 7.1 before 9.1 contains a memory leak vulnerability in eb_receive_packet() in libavcodec/libsvtav1.c that returns without unreferencing the queued input frame when eb_send_frame() fails. Attackers can supply crafted video in which some frames lack Dolby Vision metadata to an SVT-AV1 encode with Dolby Vision RPU coding enabled, leaking each rejected frame's buffers or aborting in av_frame_move_ref() in builds with assertions enabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-137905
items.summary: FFmpeg 5.0 before 8.1.3 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in parse_imf_asset_map_from_xml_dom() in libavformat/imfdec.c that does not check for a missing or empty Path element in an asset map Chunk. Attackers can supply a crafted IMF ASSETMAP.xml whose Chunk lacks a Path, passing a NULL URI to the path handling functions and crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-107189
items.summary: GNU m4 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in reload_frozen_state() in src/freeze.c. When processing a malicious frozen-state file via the -R option, an attacker can trigger an oversized allocation request that crashes the program, causing denial of service. This issue was fixed in commit 69aef802fb25ab600d37210f44e5128633cbc432.

items.title: CVE-2026-137744
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Free5GC up to 4.2.3. Affected by this issue is the function SecurityAssociation.Unmarshal of the file message/payload_securityassociation.go of the component N3IWF IKEv2 Parser. The manipulation leads to denial of service. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The identifier of the patch is 41a452a74ef320393d738acd3a0491dcebe2c008. To fix this issue, it is recommended to deploy a patch.

items.title: CVE-2026-137996
items.summary: Zettlr before 4.11.0 fails to validate URI schemes in Markdown link targets, allowing attackers to launch arbitrary registered protocol handlers via Electron shell.openExternal without confirmation. Attackers can craft documents whose Ctrl/Cmd-clicked links use smb:// to leak NTLM credential hashes on Windows or invoke custom protocol handlers with attacker-controlled parameters.

items.title: CVE-2026-137951
items.summary: libexpat 2.6.0 through 2.11.0 built with XML_GE=0 and XML_UNICODE contains an out-of-bounds read in storeSelfEntityValue() because narrow string literals are treated as wide strings. Attackers can supply an XML document whose DOCTYPE declares a general entity to expose adjacent static memory through the entity value or crash the parser.

items.title: CVE-2026-124825
items.summary: A flaw was found in 389-ds-base. An integer truncation in the Content Synchronization plugin's changelog-refresh logic can cause the ns-slapd directory server process to crash when a client presents a synchronization cookie referencing an old change number relative to the server's current state, resulting in a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-127118
items.summary: RCDevs OpenOTP SMS integration connector does not validate the TLS certificate of the remote endpoint, and transmitted the connection credentials and the message content as parameters in the request URL. items.title: CVE-2026-123762
items.summary: A catalog zone update introducing a new zone which already exists, but in a different backend than the one storing the catalog zone, will cause a duplicate zone to be created in that backend, and (depending on the backend load order) may completely hide the existing zone.

items.title: CVE-2026-123761
items.summary: Various logic errors in view processing can cause incorrect cached results to be returned.

items.title: CVE-2026-123760
items.summary: When using the LMDB backend, performing zone rectification when the number of Empty Non-Terminal entries is larger than the max-ent-entries setting triggers a logic bug and causes the PowerDNS process to spin with the LMDB database locked.

items.title: CVE-2026-137940
items.summary: Pillow through 13.1.0 contains an integer overflow in the ImageMath integer divide and modulo operators (DIV_I and MOD_I in src/_imagingmath.c), which guard only against a zero divisor, so dividing INT32_MIN by -1 raises a hardware divide exception. Attackers can supply a crafted TIFF that decodes to a mode I image containing INT32_MIN, crashing applications that run an ImageMath divide or modulo with a -1 operand on it.

items.title: CVE-2026-137937
items.summary: PDFio before 1.6.5 contains an integer underflow in _pdfioCryptoAESDecrypt() in pdfio-aes.c, which strips PKCS#7 padding before any AES block has been decrypted when an AES-encrypted string or binary value holds only its 16-byte IV. Attackers can supply a crafted AES-encrypted PDF that, when opened with pdfioFileOpen(), makes the decrypted length underflow so that _pdfioValueDecrypt() reads and writes out of bounds, crashing the application or corrupting heap memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-137936
items.summary: Payload 3.25.0 before 3.90.0 and 4.0.0-canary.0 before 4.0.0-canary.34 contains an authorization bypass through a user-controlled key in its client upload handling, which used the upload collection supplied by the client instead of the one selected by the server. In deployments that use client uploads across multiple upload collections, an authenticated user with upload permissions can access files outside their authorized collection.

items.title: CVE-2026-124728
items.summary: Incomplete GSS negotiation, as well as TKEY context deletion while a pending operation will need to be signed with that key, can lead to a crash.

items.title: CVE-2026-124727

items.title: CVE-2026-123764
items.summary: Incorrect sanitization of received data during zone AXFR to Bind backend can cause wrong or invalid data to be serialized.

items.title: CVE-2026-123758
items.summary: A race condition in the handling of the forward notification requests queue can lead to a crash if too many UDP notify packets for a given zone are received in a short time frame.

items.title: CVE-2026-123757
items.summary: An attacker can send a notify request that causes the root zone to be added as a secondary domain to be added to the bind backend, but causes said backend to update its configuration to an invalid one, leading to the backend no longer able to run on the next restart, requiring manual operation to fix it. The general case of this problem was addressed by SA-2026-05, but the root zone was not handled correctly. This is now fixed.

items.title: CVE-2026-137942
items.summary: Roundcube Webmail before 1.6.19 and 1.7.x before 1.7.4 contains an authorization bypass in add_to_group() and remove_from_group() in program/lib/Roundcube/rcube_contacts.php, which did not verify that the contact group and the contacts belong to the current user. An authenticated user of the SQL address book can supply other users' group and contact identifiers to add contacts to or remove them from other users' contact groups, or to add other users' contacts to their own groups.

items.title: CVE-2026-85567
items.summary: Setting an empty API key was not properly disabling access to the internal HTTP API, despite being documented as such. This allowed an attacker whose IP address was allowed by the webserver ACL to bypass the authentication and get read-only access to the API.

items.title: CVE-2026-85563
items.summary: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and a caching HTTP reverse proxy is used in front of DNSdist, it is possible to pollute the cache of the HTTP reverse proxy by sending DNS over HTTPS GET queries with a body. DNSdist should either refuse the query or ignore the HTTP body, but instead was processing the content of the HTTP body rather than the query present in the HTTP path.

items.title: CVE-2026-85562
items.summary: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, and the reverse proxy placed in front of DNSdist does not replace existing X-Forwarded-For headers but merely append a new header to the query, the first header was used by DNSdist instead of the last one, making it possible for a client to spoof its own IP address.

items.title: CVE-2026-85561
items.summary: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, in addition to the use of the proxy protocol being enabled between DNSdist and one of its backends, an outgoing TCP connection could be wrongly reused for a query received over the same incoming DNS over HTTPS connection but with a different X-Forwarded-For header, causing the backend to consider the query as coming from the same remote client than the first query received on the outgoing connection.

items.title: CVE-2026-123756
items.summary: An attacker can cause a denial of service by sending crafted HTTP queries to the internal webserver. The webserver is not enabled by default and is protected by an ACL.

items.title: CVE-2026-123755
items.summary: An attacker allowed to send AXFR or IXFR queries can cause an outgoing TCP connection to the backend to be stuck, causing a denial of service to other clients trying to reuse the same outgoing connection.

items.title: CVE-2026-85565
items.summary: An attacker can trigger a synchronization issue on outgoing TCP connections between DNSdist and its backend by sending oversized DNS over HTTPS queries. This could cause the backend to refuse queries, send a server failure, or just close the TCP connection.

items.title: CVE-2026-85564
items.summary: An attacker can trigger a large memory use by cancelling QUIC streams while DNSdist is retrieving the response from its backend. Instead of releasing the memory corresponding to the cancelled stream right away, DNSdist was mistakenly keeping it around until the end of the QUIC connection.

items.summary: Greece expects to launch its national electronic ID, GReID, to the public in early 2027 after formally notifying the scheme under the EU’s eIDAS rules on November 4, according to SpearIT, which helped develop it. Once it launches, Greek citizens will be able to use GReID to sign in to eligible public services in other EU countries. In a November 23 case study , SpearIT says it served as lead technical and compliance architect for the scheme, including governance design, drafting the national legal framework, and coordinating a consortium of technology vendors. The firm also offers consultancy…

items.title: St. Kitts and Nevis prepares to issue digital ID cards after Taiwan handover
items.summary: St. Kitts and Nevis is preparing to enroll citizens and issue its first national digital ID cards after Taiwan formally handed over the Digital Identity and Authentication System on November 25. The handover completed the first phase of the project. The government says the next phase will include setting up a card distribution office within the Ministry of National Security. In Phase Two of the project, authorities will issue digital ID cards equipped with secure electronic chips and secure data storage. They have also received software to enable the production and personalization of the cards…

items.title: The End of Vulnerability-Only Security
items.summary: Cybersecurity has traditionally focused heavily on finding and eliminating vulnerabilities. But AI is accelerating vulnerability discovery, making it increasingly difficult for organizations to keep up. If vulnerabilities continue to outpace remediation, eliminating every flaw may no longer be a realistic security strategy. Organizations may need to consider other factors in the risk equation, including exposure, impact, and prioritization. If we can't fix every vulnerability, what should cybersecurity teams focus on to reduce risk? Subscribe to our podcasts: https://securityweekly.com/subscri…

items.title: kernel: vdpa_sim_blk: reject out-of-range sector starts
items.summary: A flaw was found in the Linux kernel's vDPA vHost Data Path Acceleration block simulator driver. Due to improper input validation, the driver logs out-of-range starting sector requests but fails to reject them, causing an arithmetic underflow and an invalid buffer offset. An attacker with access to the simulated device, such as a guest virtual machine, can submit a crafted storage request to trigger out-of-bounds memory reads and writes in the host kernel. This flaw may result in a system crash leading to a denial of service, information disclosure, or arbitrary code execution...
